title: 27. Como ser fascinante aos olhos das mulheres

queries.text: "na década de 90" rendered "in the 1990s" (number check warning expected).

Robert A. Johnson (1987, Portuguese edition); the quotation is translated from the author’s Portuguese, since the English original is copyrighted. The bibliography lists "She: A Chave do Entendimento da Psicologia Feminina", i.e. "She: Understanding Feminine Psychology".
Vinícius de Moraes, "Que me perdoem as feias, mas beleza é fundamental" (from the poem "Receita de mulher"); translated literally.

Ram Dass (1997, Portuguese edition); translated from the author’s Portuguese, since the English original is copyrighted. Source: Ram Dass, "Promises and Pitfalls of the Spiritual Path," in Grof and Grof (eds.), "Spiritual Emergency" (1989).
Nelson Rodrigues’s play "Bonitinha, mas Ordinária" (1962) has no established English title; rendered "Pretty but Wicked". Alternatives: "Cute but Common", "Pretty but Trashy".
"kuhikuru" in the original; corrected to Kuikuro, an Indigenous people of the Upper Xingu in Brazil.

translator_notes.text: In Brazil a "motel" is typically a love hotel rented by the hour; the English reader may miss this connotation.
